title: OfferSemanticModel
description: The canonical understanding of an offer — 'what is this?' answered once for the whole platform (plans/OFFER_SEMANTIC_ANALYZER.md). Pure MEANING: no SEO, URL, formatting, or channel logic. Split into `facts` (stable values the offer has) and `interpretation` (opinions: weights/confidence/source, isolated so improving them never touches facts). The deterministic core populates the honestly-derivable subset; the AI enrichment tier (plans/OFFER_SEMANTIC_P4.md) fills the soft fields (audience, urgency, deep taxonomy, extracted attributes, tuned concepts) and is validated against this contract. Consumers degrade gracefully on missing / low-confidence fields.

entities.description: The offer's subject(s). primary is the headline entity; secondary exposes every other landing product so a consumer can decide whether to use them.

brand.description: The storefront brand, already resolved. null when the offer has no brand.

taxonomy.description: The category hierarchy, recursive/variable-depth (the breadcrumb IS the hierarchy). Deterministic core is shallow (one humanized category, or empty for a mixed bundle); the AI tier deepens it.

intent.description: Broad, channel-neutral intent. commercial is deterministic; audience/fulfillment/acquisition/urgency are reserved for the AI tier (empty strings until then).

commerce.description: Fully deterministic; useful far beyond SEO (analytics, funnel tooling). Counts, not booleans, where a range matters.

attributes.description: Unweighted facts: quantity-pricing, subscription; later flavor/size/quantity extracted from names.

interpretation.description: Opinions, isolated from facts. key_concepts, confidence, and the provenance of this model.

key_concepts.description: The offer's important concepts, weighted. Domain-neutral (feeds AI/ads, not just SEO).

confidence.description: Per-field confidence (dotted field path -> 0..1), NOT one global score.

generated_at.description: Epoch seconds; stamped when a model is cached (AI tier). Absent on a freshly-computed deterministic model (a pure function).
